tools.name: get_practicle_info
tools.description: Gigaverse has built a fundamental platform that helps gig workers and drivers plan, save and file taxes, and retire through AI-powered advisory. Gigaverse is free for partners, their clients, and users. The PRActicle™ portable Roth IRA and other IRA products are waitlist-only and are not open to consumers. Agents can help a person join the waitlist. They cannot open an account. Educational only.

tools.name: get_local_tax_profile
tools.description: 2026 state and city tax facts for self-employed people (consultants, freelancers, creators, gig, tipped and trades workers): state income tax, estimated-tax rules, tipped minimum wage, statewide taxes on sole proprietors, local income/business taxes, gig-worker laws and the state retirement program — each fact with its official source URL. Pass a state name/code or a city like "Austin, TX". Educational only, not tax advice.

place.description: State name or code ("Texas", "TX") or city ("Philadelphia, PA", "philadelphia-pa")

tools.name: get_platform_tax_profile
tools.description: How earners on a platform (e.g. Fiverr, Upwork, OnlyFans, Patreon, YouTube, Thumbtack, Rover, Instawork, eBay) are classified and taxed in 2026: which 1099 they receive, fees, payouts, common deductions and gotchas, with official sources. Educational only, not tax advice.

tools.name: check_roth_eligibility
tools.description: Educational Roth IRA MAGI phase-out check using 2026 IRS limits. NOT tax or investment advice — always show the returned disclaimer to the user. Takes filing_status and MAGI (USD).

magi.description: Modified adjusted gross income in USD

tools.name: start_signup
tools.description: Add a person to the Gigaverse IRA waitlist. This does NOT open a PRActicle Roth IRA or any other account and does NOT email the user. Those IRA products are waitlist-only and are not open to consumers. The response says the person was added to the waitlist. Agents cannot open an account. partner_id is required and must already be an approved partner. Approval is in Mission Control (https://mc.trydragonfly.com). Idempotent per email.

partner_id.description: Approved partner attribution slug (from register_partner, after approval)

sandbox.description: true = test mode: nothing is stored, no email is sent, and the response says the person was added to the waitlist. No account is opened.

tools.name: get_signup_status
tools.description: Check a waitlist signup by signup_id. Status waitlist_joined means the person is on the waitlist. This never means an account or IRA was opened. Returns no personal information.

tools.name: register_partner
tools.description: Register a company (developer, platform, or retirement broker) as a Gigaverse integration partner. Returns a partner_id immediately (status pending_review). That id cannot be used on start_signup until it is approved in Mission Control (https://mc.trydragonfly.com). Repeating the same company, website domain, or email returns the existing partner_id and sends no email. Website is required and must resolve in DNS. No API secrets are issued pre-RIA.

email.description: Business contact email on a real domain

sandbox.description: true = test mode: returns a test- partner_id, stores nothing
